name: Empathic Link
body:
You have a deep connection with another creature.

Prerequisite(s): Wis 16

Benefit(s): You gain the ability to know the general state and emotions of a specific creature as long as they are within 100 feet. This cannot be used to convey messages or exact hit points or conditions. The target can be changed with a 1 hour ritual of meditation and close contact. However, you can only have one such connection.

Special: This feat can be taken multiple times. Each additional time, you can connect with an additional creature simultaneously.
